_comment: A community on a Symposium Data server. Copy this to community.json, edit it, and run
`/symposium bootstrap --community community.json` as the server's admin.
community: the community's name, 1-20 letters, digits or underscores. It is unique on
its server, ignoring case, and 'status', 'communities' and 'admin' are reserved.
handles: the members, one handle each. Bootstrap adds them to the roster and writes one
invite file per member, `<community>-<handle>.invite`, to hand over out of band. Adding
a member later: add the handle here and run bootstrap again. It only adds; nobody is
ever removed by it. The server admin's own handle can never be a member.
data-server-url: the data server the community lives on. One server hosts many
communities, and every community inherits its server's admin: there is no admin field.
Names only: nothing secret ever belongs in this file.
